name: Ajay Sukhdeve
review: 5KW on-grid system installed by Solar Skylink team. Very professional workmanship and complete MSEB paperwork handled by them end-to-end. My monthly electricity bill dropped from ₹4500 to under ₹300. Highly recommend to all my friends and neighbours!

name: Anil Bhongade
review: 3KW system running smoothly for 6 months. Chandu sir personally supervised the installation. Zero complaints, quick service, and the panels are still generating peak power. Very happy with the choice.

name: Anmol Shahare
review: Great experience with Solar Skylink. Team was punctual, clean and explained every wire and connection. Bifacial panels are performing better than expected during monsoon too.

name: Prakash Borkar
review: Installed 6.6KW for our shop and residence combined. Payback in less than 5 years as promised. Wireless monitoring app is a great bonus — I can see generation from anywhere.

name: Ramesh Gedam
review: 3KW rooftop plant on my house. Even in Gadchiroli our MSEB office was hesitant but Solar Skylink handled all liaising. Sanction came in 3 weeks. Excellent people to deal with.

name: Hemlata Dahake
review: As a homemaker I was worried about the technical side but Solar Skylink team explained everything patiently. Installation was clean, no damage to the roof. Bill has almost become zero!

name: Hemraj Ukey
review: 5KW on-grid installed on my house. Very transparent quotation, no hidden costs. Structure quality is top notch — GI hot-dipped as promised. Recommend to everyone.

name: Jayprakash Meshram
review: Excellent service from day one. Site survey, drawing, sanction, installation all completed within 30 days. My family is very happy. Thanks to entire Solar Skylink team.

name: Kamaldas Jamdal
review: Solar Skylink installed 3KW at my home. Real quality panels, real service. After 8 months everything is perfect. When I had a small doubt, they answered on WhatsApp instantly.

name: Dewaji Kodap
review: 3KW on-grid solar system with TOPCon bifacial panels. Everything from bill of material to final commissioning was exactly as promised. Very satisfied with Solar Skylink Green Energy Enterprises.

name: Nitin Vaida
review: 5KW installed on our commercial godown. Reduced our monthly running cost significantly. Team is knowledgeable and after-sales support is excellent.

name: Roshan Sarade
review: 8KW system on my two-storey house. Been generating 32-38 units per day consistently. Chandu sir designed the layout perfectly to avoid the water tank shadow. Great planning.

name: Shashikant Mesharam
review: Highly recommend Solar Skylink. 3KW plant working like new even after monsoon. Panels self-cleaned by rain. No complaints, only good things to say.

name: Swapnil Kolhatkar
review: 6.6KW rooftop system. Design was carefully done to fit our L-shaped rooftop. Structure is very sturdy. Only very minor delay in net-metering approval but that was MSEB's side.

name: Vijay Wahane
review: 5KW plant on my farmhouse. Solar Skylink is the most trustworthy solar company I have worked with. Genuine components, no shortcuts, no upselling. Just honest engineering.
